executeWithProof(uint256[2],uint256[2][2.notice: ZK-gated entry. Same execution path as execute(), but requires a valid Groth16 proof first (3 public signals: [nullifier, profit_usd, net_profit_usd]). The proof certifies a profitable cross-venue state existed without revealing the route; actual trade profitability is still enforced by NoProfit() below.
